cohort: The study included 180 women with singleton postdated pregnancies (>=40 weeks gestation).
finding: Postdated pregnancy is associated with increased maternal intervention and adverse perinatal outcomes, with fetal complications like meconium-stained amniotic fluid, low Apgar scores, NICU admission, and macrosomia being more frequent with advancing gestational age.
mod_finding: An increased rate of caesarean section was observed in pregnancies beyond 41 weeks.
birth_weight: Macrosomia was mentioned as a complication.
gest_age: Gestation extending beyond 40 completed weeks (>=40 weeks gestation), with analysis also focusing on pregnancies beyond 41 weeks.
